tasks.name: Write tests for the job DTOs
tasks.description: Extend agency_sdk/test/test_annotations_dto.py with fixtures built from the real gts-comand structs (90f95ad8): a full AnnotationJob payload, an AnnotationJobSummary page, and a JobTransitionEntry page. Assert (a) every field in FR5 survives parsing with nothing dropped, (b) annotation_data / checklist_state / delta round-trip an unusual shape unvalidated and unreshaped (FR6), (c) state_code parses as a plain str, not an enum (FR7), (d) explicit nulls on the optional fields parse — the server serialises nulls rather than omitting them. Tests must fail (red) before implementation.

tasks.name: Implement AnnotationJobSummary, AnnotationJob, JobTransitionEntry and the paged wrappers
tasks.description: Add the five models to agency_sdk/delegates/annotations_dto.py per FR5. AnnotationJob is a standalone BaseModel, NOT a subclass of AnnotationJobSummary (they are two distinct server structs; inheritance would claim a substitutability the API does not promise). Blob fields typed Any and nullable; state_code a str; revision documented as the optimistic-concurrency counter the Publisher's drift fence snapshots. JobTransitionEntry.note carries the PHI never-log instruction in its own field documentation (FR8), and workflow_version_id is documented as the version in force when the transition fired, not the job's current one. Paged wrappers reuse the shared Page from datasets_dto.

tasks.name: Phase verification & checkpoint
tasks.description: Per workflow.md: pytest agency_sdk/test/ -v, mypy agency_sdk/, black --check, coverage on the new models; then the manual verification plan and checkpoint commit with its git note.

tasks.name: Write protocol tests for list_jobs and get_job
tasks.description: In agency_sdk/test/test_annotations_client.py, assert the exact URL and query params: list_jobs -> GET {base}/api/annotations/{batch_id}/jobs with params o/p/s as strings; get_job -> GET {base}/api/annotations/{batch_id}/jobs/{job_id} with param o only and no pagination. Assert the parsed result types and that list_jobs surfaces summaries only. Red before green.

tasks.name: Implement list_jobs and get_job
tasks.description: Add both methods to AgencyAnnotationsClient over _make_request, organisation_id positional-first per the delegate's convention. list_jobs docstring states the summary-vs-full distinction explicitly — the server excludes the heavy payloads by design (the deferred join exists to keep those wide rows off the page), so a caller needing vertex_data / connected_* / delta / checklist_state / annotation_data must follow up with get_job.

tasks.name: Write protocol tests for list_job_transitions and get_graph
tasks.description: Assert list_job_transitions sends organisation/page/size SPELLED OUT — not o/p/s — with a test named so its intent survives a future consistency refactor; the server's OrganisationQuery is the contract and mirroring it is deliberate, not an oversight. Assert get_graph hits {batch_id}/graph with param o and returns the raw dict unchanged (identity of content, no DTO). Red before green.

tasks.name: Implement list_job_transitions and get_graph
tasks.description: Add both methods. list_job_transitions builds its params from the transitions endpoint's own names; get_graph returns dict[str, Any] straight from _make_request with no model. Docstrings record why the param names differ and why the graph is deliberately unmodelled (it is the caller's own upload echoed back). No write-path methods (FR9).

tasks.name: Phase verification & checkpoint
tasks.description: Per workflow.md: full offline suite, mypy strict, black --check, bandit, coverage >80% on the new methods; manual verification plan, checkpoint commit and git note.

tasks.name: Extend examples/quick_annotations.py with the read-back leg
tasks.description: After the existing push_graph step — which has already materialised real jobs — add: list_jobs on that batch, get_job on the first summary, list_job_transitions on it, and get_graph cross-checked against the graph the script uploaded. Self-verifying (assertions, non-zero exit on failure) and idempotent, matching the script's existing style and its unconditional archive cleanup. The transition note is never printed.

tasks.name: Document the read-back path
tasks.description: Add a 'Reading a batch back' section to docs/annotations.md covering the four methods, the summary-vs-full split, the per-endpoint param-name inconsistency, the opaque-blob rule, and the PHI warning on transition notes. Update the annotations bullet in CLAUDE.md per the Delegate Delivery Checklist. Note in docs that no server-side completed filter exists and callers filter list_batches client-side.

If the local stack is not available, raise it as a blocker rather than doing environment work here: standing up the stack belongs to gts-local-environment, not this repo.
